How It Works

Get started in minutes with three simple steps

  1. 1

    Add your meal prep, snacks, and pantry items

    Log what you've prepped or bought — fridge, freezer, pantry, and snacks. AI-assisted nutrition estimates fill in the gaps for home-cooked, takeout, and restaurant meals.

  2. 2

    Set your nutrition goals and preferences

    Pick daily and weekly targets for calories, protein, and fiber (carbs and fat too, if you want them). Tell Plenish how you like to eat.

  3. 3

    Get a personalized 1–4 week meal plan

    Plenish builds your plan around what's freshest and what hits your goals — so you always know what to eat next.

Planning That Works on Your Timeline

Most meal planners assume your week looks like everyone else's. Plenish lets you plan the way you actually live.

Plan 1–4 weeks at a time

Pick the planning horizon that fits your life. One week if things change fast, up to four weeks if you batch cook and freeze.

Plans built around what's already prepped

Plenish starts with what's in your fridge, freezer, and pantry — so your meal plan reflects reality, not a pristine grocery list.

Track progress over time

Meal plan history and weekly nutrition trends make it easy to see how you're actually doing — not just how today went.

Always Know What to Eat Next

Track your inventory, hit your nutrition goals, and get a meal plan built around what you already have. Free to start.
